title: How to study
description: Struggling to concentrate on your assignment? Worried about delivering a presentation? Whatever academic challenges you are facing this Notebook provides the knowledge, tools and strategies to study more successfully. Drawing exclusively on a carefully curated suite of expert study skills content from Bloomsbury Publishing, you can use these sources to:, Manage time more effectively and avoid procrastination, Revise and prepare for exams, Apply critical thinking to your work, Develop a laser focus when studying, Take effective notes when reading, Work seamlessly in groups, Explore Bloomsbury's full range of study skills books covering essential academic skills as well as personal development and wellbeing.
author: Bloomsbury Publishing
